conclusion: Fails to support usefulness of the existing deterministic schedule over random search; inconclusive about ability to induce failures from correct baselines, because none were selected.
discovery_ceiling: All five baselines were accepted-but-wrong; all 15 case-seed trials per method therefore start from a known failure. Zero correct-baseline opportunities; 0 transitions must not be interpreted as an estimated 0% transition rate.
agent_scope: T-LESS local deterministic policy is fixed, not adaptive; both tested methods consume no GT feedback. Optional T-LESS live feedback is geometry-only. Separate synthetic live proposal code includes GT-derived pose_errors and classification; it was excluded and no model calls occurred.
representative: First zero-noise/zero-dropout proposal with seed 101 on object 2. This duplicates its already-wrong baseline and establishes replay consistency, not new failure induction or perturbation robustness.
no_discovery_representation: evaluations_to_first_discovery=null and no_discovery=true are supported; no such trials occurred here.
severity: No existing justified scalar severity; noise standard deviation (mm) and dropout fraction retained independently in results.jsonl. Deterministic ladder uses (0mm,0%), (1mm,5%), (3mm,10%), (5mm,20%); random uniformly samples the same allowed 0–5mm and 0–20% ranges.
limits: Five outcome-blind development cases from three scenes; three seeds reuse proposal lists across cases and are not independent case samples. Four proposals per arm, within requested maximum ten. Runtime includes subprocess startup. No live/adaptive agent claim or generalization claim; no post-outcome tuning or rerun.
focused_tests: 4 passed after retrying with access to pytest temporary directory; tests mocked registration/export data, not additional real evaluator calls.
final_read_only_integrity_checks: Verified 125 primary results (5 baseline + 120 candidate), 126 evaluator calls including replay, all 48 plan inventory hashes unchanged, ZIP saved parameters/scan count, and exact replay metric equality. No new registration run.
